data.name: Lonely Hearts
data.detailed_description:
⭐ LONELY HEARTS – LONG DESCRIPTION

Lonely Hearts is a 2D, narrative-driven relationship simulation about a solitary garbage collector surviving on the unseen edges of a vast city.
From crumbling districts to polished upper-class neighborhoods, you’ll meet women with unique personalities, build relationships through your actions, and slowly uncover a dangerous truth buried beneath the city.

Every choice matters: odor level, reputation, gift preferences, rival interactions, district differences, and mini-games all influence the fate of your connections.
What begins in piles of trash evolves into a story tangled with crime, mafia shadows, and the most delicate form of affection.

⭐ Key Features

❤️ Relationships Shaped by Your Choices

Each woman has her own temperament, boundaries, and past.
Some are gentle, some toxic, some dangerously passionate.
Your dialogue choices and behavior can completely alter the course of each relationship.

🛒 Odor & Hygiene System

Your smell affects how people react to you.
Fail to clean up after work and certain characters may avoid or reject you; stay fresh and you become more appealing.

🎁 Gift & Interaction Mechanics

Items you find or earn throughout the city can improve your relationship if given to the right person.
Every character has different likes, dislikes, and triggers.

🌆 Three Districts – Three Different Worlds

  • Poor District: Rough streets, decayed homes, harsh survival

  • Middle Class: Crowded, white-collar neighborhoods full of pressure

  • Rich District: Luxury, influence, and hidden corruption

Each area offers its own character types, side stories, and risks.

🗑 Trash-Collecting Mini-Games

Sort garbage, escape danger, discover mysterious items, and influence story progression through various mini-games.

😰 A Dark Mystery Beneath It All

The appearance of a corpse sends your life spiraling into uncertainty.
Mafia ties, unspoken relationships, and fragments of your past slowly come to light.

⭐ Gameplay Loop

Talk to characters → find the right gift → manage your odor level

⭐ Themes

  • Loneliness

  • The search for love

  • Class differences

  • Hope & despair

  • Mystery and criminal tension
